+# Concept-driven STEM Learning Workbench
+
+Search discovers objects. Opening a concept changes a **ConceptSession** without
+running another textual search. The current concept determines the work area.
+
+Query discovery now follows `Raw Query → Resolver v2 → Canonical Concept IDs →
+ConceptSession → Workbench`. Universal Search projects ranked accepted concepts
+before their capabilities. Ambiguous queries expose explicit localized concept
+choices; unknown queries retain ordinary resource search. Neither opens a
+Workbench automatically. The [resolver document](query-resolver-v2.md) owns the
+normalization, scoring, abstention and parity contract.
+
+```text
+Query / Graph / Resource / Learning Path
+                 ↓
+           ConceptSession
+                 ↓
+         Concept Workbench
+                 ↓
+         Capability Registry
+         Learn / Visualize / Read / Explore / Practice
+```
+
+## Ownership and navigation
+
+`workbench/conceptSession.ts` implements pure transitions. The separate Zustand
+store owns one Concept ID, entry provenance, surface, selected capability/lesson
+entry and a bounded trail. It owns neither SearchResponse nor search history.
+The trail holds at most 32 entries; new navigation after Back truncates Forward.
+Returning restores the surface while resetting lesson playback and resource
+selection. Reopening the current concept preserves its context.
+
+Prerequisite, related/next and graph links use canonical navigation. Resource
+preview concept links do too; in a separate resource workspace they follow the
+existing `?route=search` route with a validated `concept` parameter. Ordinary
+workspace return, notes and previews remain available. **Search resources for
+this concept** is an explicit action that closes the workbench and calls the
+existing search store.
+
+Per-window `sve.workbench.v1` sessionStorage contains only validated Concept IDs,
+surfaces and trail cursor. **Resume Concept Session** restores them explicitly.
+Queries, origins, resource payloads, lesson state and commands are not persisted.
+Malformed histories are rejected; unavailable surfaces become Overview. Storage
+failure is non-fatal.
+
+## Resource resolution
+
+`resolveConceptResources(conceptId)` reuses webIndex's manifest, provider-index
+validation, pending-request deduplication and caches on Web and Tauri. The
+reviewed static indexes ship with both frontends. `resourcesForConcept` selects
+direct `concept_ids` membership and sorts by provider/title/ID. It never uses
+the last query, exploratory matches or last search response. Ordinary provider
+search retains its enabled-provider, ranking and native Rust behavior.
+
+Workbench resources are **known snapshot resources**, including providers
+disabled for ordinary search. They are not a live native refresh. Partial
+failures retain successful providers and show missing sources with Retry.
+Empty concepts offer ordinary resource search. A concept change clears the
+display immediately; obsolete asynchronous loads cannot publish into the
+replacement workbench.
+
+## Capability registry and curriculum
+
+`capabilities/registry.ts` adapts existing learning profiles, lightweight
+visualization metadata, curriculum references and provider entries. Original
+data stays in its owning module. IDs, Concept IDs, typed kind and native/external
+availability form the unified read model.
+
+Guided lessons map to Learn; standalone visualizations to Visualize;
+articles/textbooks/proofs to Read; simulations to Explore; exercises to Practice.
+Empty groups disappear. A guided lesson also opens in the dominant Visualize
+surface as another view of the same capability. Proof/exercise types are
+supported without inventing content. Provider resources are classified
+conservatively; proof or license status is never inferred from a title.
+
+`learning/curriculum.ts` defines CurriculumSource and one real adapter for
+数理化自学丛书. Its seven original reviewed references retain source/book/section,
+language, URL and rights provenance. No prose, scan or illustration is imported.
+External provider licenses remain **unknown** when no metadata exists.
+Historical spellings stay outside the canonical ontology and use existing
+shared TS/Rust recognition.
+
+## Surfaces and Inspector
+
+- Overview: semantic identity, prerequisites, next/related concepts, capabilities.
+- Learn: objectives and ordered teaching path; stages open reviewed lesson steps.
+- Visualize: dominant numeric board, authored equations, controls, descriptions
+  and reduced-motion snapshots.
+- Resources: direct annotations, textbook paths and only represented type
+  filters. Selecting a row changes Inspector provenance.
+- Graph: deterministic current node plus one-hop prerequisite/next/related
+  relation groups. Default limit: 20 nodes. No force simulation or graph backend.
+
+The Inspector follows concept, resource or lesson context. The common player
+publishes step/status/parameter changes and registered reducer actions, not
+per-frame animation ticks. Optional observation/cause/consequence/misconception
+fields contain reviewed trilingual examples at SHM crossing, ellipse focal sum
+and determinant area; other steps receive no filler.
+
+Desktop uses navigation / work area / Inspector. Below 1200px Inspector becomes
+a toggleable panel; below 650px navigation also collapses. The center scrolls
+independently, lesson controls stay accessible, and 390px tests verify overflow
+and actual board geometry. Landmarks, headings, focus, labels, equations and
+textual relation names preserve keyboard and screen-reader access.
+
+## Universal Search and commands
+
+SearchBar retains provider queries and history suggestions. Object suggestions
+use the existing `parseAndExpand`, then project Concept, Lesson, Visualization,
+Textbook and Graph-command entries in deterministic categories. Resource entries
+require a matching current search response. This is bounded object search,
+not a second fuzzy/semantic resolver.
+
+`registeredCommands(context)` creates local actions from available surfaces,
+graph projection and live lesson actions. Play disappears for unavailable or
+reduced motion; Previous/Next respect bounds. No command string is executed.
+The palette supports filtering, arrows, Enter, Tab containment and focus return.
+
+| Shortcut | Behavior |
+| --- | --- |
+| Ctrl/Cmd+K | Toggle Command Palette, including from a typing control. |
+| Ctrl/Cmd+L | Focus universal search. |
+| Escape | Close palette, expanded workbench panel or workbench. |
+| Alt+Left / Alt+Right | Navigate concept trail when not typing and a destination exists. |
+
+Existing search-list and lesson controls remain in their own context.
+
+## Lesson loading and security
+
+The small visualization catalog registers explicit dynamic imports for
+`lessons/shm.ts`, `ellipse.ts`, `linear.ts`. LazyLesson loads only the selected
+definition, then the shared player. JSXGraph, KaTeX and equation rendering remain
+lazy; Overview and Resources load neither. `definitions.ts` is an eager
+compatibility barrel for offline schema/math tests only. Production never
+imports it. Shared reducer/math/scenes/renderer remain reusable.
+
+JSXGraph is pinned to **1.13.3**. Vite substitutes fail-closed JessieCode and
+Geonext interfaces and removes the obsolete Function ES6 probe with an
+exact-source guard. Numeric callbacks and SVG primitives are reviewed source;
+no generated JavaScript or dependency source vendoring is involved.
+**JSXGraph upgrades require explicit security review.**
+
+Build provenance rejects original JSXGraph parser modules and unexpected
+versions, recording `visualization-boundary.json`. `test:visual-bundle` parses
+final JS assets with the TypeScript AST, checking global eval/Function call/new
+syntax, indirect comma calls and global-object call/apply/bind. Strings/comments
+and JSXGraph's numeric `.eval` callback helper are not JavaScript execution.
+This targeted invariant is complemented by real interactions with global
+eval/Function blocked; it is not a general-purpose security analyzer.
+
+External links retain httpUrl, Tauri boundaries and existing preview policies.
+No CSP, arbitrary iframe or remote-script permission is expanded.
+
+## Extension guide
+
+1. Reuse a reviewed canonical Concept ID and create a real learning profile.
+2. Add a static independently loaded definition and lightweight catalog entry.
+3. Reuse the common reducer/renderer or introduce an explicit reviewed adapter.
+4. Add mathematical invariants, complete localization and capability adapters.
+5. Add metadata-only curriculum sources with actual provenance/rights status.
+6. Register commands only for implemented actions.
+7. Run schema/math, context, browser, native and final-asset checks.
+
+The independent Adversarial Query Robustness Benchmark stores 220 reviewed
+queries separately from gold expectations. It measures this resolver's lexical
+robustness, not general semantic understanding. Weak scores and case-level
+failures remain in its output. It does not replace canonical benchmark/parity
+gates. See the validation report for metrics and limitations.

+import data from "./rules.json" with { type: "json" };
+export const MAX_QUERY_LENGTH = 512;
+const replacements = new Map(Object.entries(data.characters));
+const scripts = new Map(Object.entries(data.scripts));
+/** Mechanical normalization only. No concept names or student phrases are rewritten. */
+export function normalizeQuery(raw: string): string {
+  return Array.from(raw)
+    .map((c) => replacements.get(c) ?? c)
+    .join("")
+    .normalize("NFKC")
+    .toLowerCase()
+    .split("")
+    .map((c) => replacements.get(c) ?? c)
+    .join("")
+    .split("")
+    .map((c) => scripts.get(c) ?? c)
+    .join("")
+    .replace(/[’‘]/g, "'")
+    .replace(/[‐‑–—−]/g, "-")
+    .replace(/[，、；：！？]/g, " ")
+    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
+    .trim();
+}

+    primitive("plot-end", "point", [[2, -3.45]], "muted", n >= 4, "T"),
+    primitive("plot", "path", plot, "position", n >= 4),
+    primitive(
+      "plot-marker",
+      "point",

+      "force",
+      n >= 4,
+      "x(t)",
+    ),
+    primitive(
+      "kinetic",

+      "velocity",
+      n === 9,
+    ),
+    primitive(
+      "potential",
+      "polygon",
+      rect(3.6, -3.2, 0.24, (2 * s.potential) / total),
+      "force",
+      n === 9,
+    ),
+    primitive(
+      "total",
+      "polygon",
+      rect(4.15, -3.2, 0.24, 2),
+      "position",

+    ...["K", "U", "E"].map((label, i) =>
+      primitive(
+        `energy-label-${i}`,
+        "point",
+        [[3.12 + i * 0.55, -3.5]],

+  return {

+    primitives,
+    readouts: [
+      { label: "x", value: s.x, unit: "m" },
+      { label: "v", value: s.v, unit: "m/s" },
+      { label: "F", value: s.force, unit: "N" },
+      { label: "a", value: s.acceleration, unit: "m/s²" },
+      { label: "ω", value: s.omega, unit: "rad/s" },
+      { label: "T", value: s.period, unit: "s" },
+      ...(n === 9
+        ? [
+            { label: "K", value: s.kinetic, unit: "J" },
+            { label: "U", value: s.potential, unit: "J" },

+          ]

+}
+function ellipseFrame(
+  definition: GuidedVisualizationDefinition,
+  state: LessonState,
+): SceneFrame {
+  const n = definition.steps[state.stepIndex].scene.stage,
+    { a, c } = state.parameters;
+  const theta =
+    n === 5
+      ? Math.PI / 2
+      : ellipseTheta(state, lessonDuration(definition, state));
+  const e = ellipseState(a, c, theta),
+    top: Vec2 = [0, e.b];
+  const locus =
+    n === 3
+      ? state.trace.length > 1
+        ? state.trace
+        : [e.point, e.point]
+      : curve((t) => ellipseState(a, c, t).point, 0, TAU);
+  const extent = a + 0.7;
+  return {
+    bounds: [-extent, extent, extent, -extent],
+    primitives: [
+      primitive(
+        "axis-x",
+        "path",
+        [
+          [-4.5, 0],
+          [4.5, 0],
+        ],
+        "muted",
+      ),
+      primitive(
+        "axis-y",
+        "path",
+        [
+          [0, -4.5],
+          [0, 4.5],
+        ],
+        "muted",
+      ),
+      primitive("f1", "point", [[-c, 0]], "force", true, "F₁"),
+      primitive("f2", "point", [[c, 0]], "force", true, "F₂"),
+      primitive("locus", "path", locus, "position", n >= 3),
+      primitive("r1", "path", [[-c, 0], e.point], "force", n >= 1),
+      primitive("r2", "path", [[c, 0], e.point], "velocity", n >= 1),
+      primitive(
+        "p",
+        "point",
+        [e.point],
+        "position",
+        n >= 1,
+        "P",
+        n !== 5 ? { draggable: "ellipse-point" } : {},
+      ),
+      primitive(
+        "axis-a",
+        "arrow",
+        [
+          [0, 0],
+          [a, 0],
+        ],
+        "position",
+        n >= 4,
+        "a",
+      ),
+      primitive("axis-b", "arrow", [[0, 0], top], "velocity", n >= 4, "b"),
+      primitive(
+        "axis-c",
+        "arrow",
+        [
+          [0, -0.35],
+          [c, -0.35],
+        ],
+        "force",
+        n >= 4 && c > 0,
+        "c",
+      ),
+      primitive(
+        "triangle",
+        "path",
+        [[0, 0], [c, 0], top, [0, 0]],
+        "ink",
+        n === 5,
+      ),
+    ],
+    readouts: [
+      { label: "a", value: a },
+      { label: "b", value: e.b },
+      { label: "c", value: c },
+      ...(n >= 1
+        ? [
+            { label: "PF₁", value: e.r1 },
+            { label: "PF₂", value: e.r2 },
+            { label: "PF₁ + PF₂", value: e.sum },
+          ]
+        : []),
+      ...(n === 6
+        ? [
+            {
+              label: "x²/a² + y²/b²",
+              value: e.point[0] ** 2 / a ** 2 + e.point[1] ** 2 / e.b ** 2,
+            },
+          ]
+        : []),
+    ],
+  };
+}
+export function currentMatrix(
+  definition: GuidedVisualizationDefinition,
+  state: LessonState,
+): Matrix2 {
+  const n = definition.steps[state.stepIndex].scene.stage;
+  const A = state.parameters as unknown as Matrix2;
+  if (n === 0) return { a: 1, b: 0, c: 0, d: 1 };
+  const s =
+    n === 2 || n === 6
+      ? state.status === "playing" || state.elapsed > 0
+        ? clamp(state.elapsed / lessonDuration(definition, state), 0, 1)
+        : state.parameters.blend
+      : 1;
+  return interpolateMatrix(A, s);
+}
+function linearFrame(
+  definition: GuidedVisualizationDefinition,
+  state: LessonState,
+): SceneFrame {
+  const n = definition.steps[state.stepIndex].scene.stage,
+    B = currentMatrix(definition, state);
+  const e1 = transform(B, [1, 0]),
+    e2 = transform(B, [0, 1]);
+  const square: Vec2[] = [
+    [0, 0],
+    [1, 0],
+    [1, 1],
+    [0, 1],
+  ];
+  const image = square.map((p) => transform(B, p));
+  const grid: ScenePrimitive[] = [];
+  for (let i = -3; i <= 3; i++)
+    for (const vertical of [true, false]) {
+      const line: Vec2[] = vertical
+        ? [
+            [i, -3],
+            [i, 3],
+          ]
+        : [
+            [-3, i],
+            [3, i],
+          ];
+      grid.push(
+        primitive(
+          `original-grid-${i}-${vertical}`,
+          "path",
+          line,
+          "muted",
+          true,
+          undefined,
+          { dashed: true },
+        ),
+      );
+      grid.push(
+        primitive(
+          `grid-${i}-${vertical}`,
+          "path",
+          line.map((p) => transform(B, p)),
+          "position",
+          n >= 2,
+        ),
+      );
+    }
+  const extent = Math.max(
+    3.7,
+    Math.abs(B.a) + Math.abs(B.b) + 1.2,
+    Math.abs(B.c) + Math.abs(B.d) + 1.2,
+  );
+  return {
+    bounds: [-extent, extent, extent, -extent],
+    primitives: [
+      ...grid,
+      primitive("square", "polygon", square, "muted"),
+      primitive("image", "polygon", image, "position", n >= 3),
+      primitive(
+        "e1",
+        "arrow",
+        [[0, 0], e1],
+        "force",
+        true,
+        n === 0 ? "e₁" : n === 2 || n === 6 ? "Be₁" : "Ae₁",
+      ),
+      primitive(
+        "e2",
+        "arrow",
+        [[0, 0], e2],
+        "velocity",
+        true,
+        n === 0 ? "e₂" : n === 2 || n === 6 ? "Be₂" : "Ae₂",
+      ),
+      ...image.map((p, i) =>
+        primitive(`corner${i}`, "point", [p], "ink", n >= 5, String(i)),
+      ),
+    ],
+    readouts: [
+      {
+        label: "det(A)",
+        value: determinant(state.parameters as unknown as Matrix2),
+      },
+      { label: "det(B)", value: determinant(B) },
+      { label: "|det(B)|", value: Math.abs(determinant(B)) },
+    ],
+  };
+}
+export function buildScene(
+  definition: GuidedVisualizationDefinition,
+  state: LessonState,
+): SceneFrame {
+  switch (definition.steps[state.stepIndex].scene.family) {
+    case "shm":
+      return shmFrame(definition, state);
+    case "ellipse":
+      return ellipseFrame(definition, state);
+    case "linear":
+      return linearFrame(definition, state);
+  }
+}

commit.message: feat(learning): add concept profiles and reviewed textbook paths
feat(visualization): add numeric guided engine and three STEM lessons
feat(learning): connect concept pages with visual lessons and browser regressions
fix(visualization): preserve scene bounds when resizing the board
docs: document visual learning architecture and validation
test: write regression progress to explicit CLI output
feat(workbench): unify concept sessions, capabilities and learning surfaces
test(workbench): cover workflows, execution boundaries and adversarial queries
docs: document workbench architecture, validation and screenshots
ci: validate exact stacked PR heads with CodeQL
test: validate translation URL origins precisely
feat(query): add deterministic multilingual resolver with Rust parity and safety gates
docs(query): report resolver gains and unresolved holdout generalization gap
fix(ci): route resolver CLI reports through explicit output interfaces

<!-- account-closeout:20261102:blocker -->

Account-closeout disposition: **E — blocked pending independent validation and product decision**.

This remains open, not merged. The PR itself reports a 26.06 percentage-point development-to-holdout gap and only 20% colloquial/formula holdout accuracy, across a large 100-file experimental resolver change. Current CI does not resolve that generalization/acceptance gap.

Next required action: evaluate against an independently curated holdout set without tuning on it, then decide whether the restricted/experimental behavior is acceptable to ship. No production release, tag, signing identity or published asset was changed by this review.

+name: Disposable package integration
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - 'src/**'
+      - 'config/packages.json'
+      - 'tests/Run-DisposablePackageTest.ps1'
+      - '.github/workflows/disposable-integration.yml'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  package-component:
+    runs-on: windows-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
+      - name: Provision WinGet on disposable runner only
+        shell: pwsh
+        run: |
+          # Microsoft's supported bootstrap: https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/package-manager/winget/
+          if (-not (Get-Command winget.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
+            Install-Module Microsoft.WinGet.Client -Repository PSGallery -Scope CurrentUser -Force
+            Repair-WinGetPackageManager -AllUsers
+          }
+          winget --version
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'WinGet provisioning failed.' }
+      - name: Fresh Notepad3 installation and repeated package recheck
+        shell: pwsh
+        run: ./tests/Run-DisposablePackageTest.ps1 -EvidencePath "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/real-package.json"
+      - name: Upload real package evidence
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
+        with:
+          name: disposable-package-evidence
+          path: |
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/real-package.json
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/real-package-state
+          if-no-files-found: error

 - Restart may be required. Whinset never restarts Windows automatically.

+The [machine-readable matrix](windows-v2.0.0-rc.2.json) distinguishes PASS, FAIL, NOT RUN, BLOCKED and NOT APPLICABLE. Each PASS identifies its evidence scope. It records the tested runtime revision; later release metadata/version preparation is verified by the release-preparation PR CI.

+| Evidence | Result | Scope |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| [PowerShell CI](https://github.com/styayur/whinset/actions/runs/42263019789) | PASS | PowerShell 5.1 and 7 legacy/Whinset/hardening suites; static analysis, catalog/module checks and reproducible builds |
+| [Hosted shell snapshot](evidence/rc2-shells-ci.json) | 17 PASS; Nushell NOT RUN | Real read-only CLI invocation: PS5.1, PS7, CMD, Git Bash and module checks |
+| [Local shell snapshot](evidence/rc2-shells-local.json) | 21 PASS | Same read-only checks plus Nushell 0.116.1 |
+| [Hardening PS5.1](evidence/rc2-hardening-ps51.json) / [PS7](evidence/rc2-hardening-ps7.json) | 19 PASS each | Simulated UAC/transport/operations; actual temporary state-file/ACL I/O |
+| [Disposable package integration](https://github.com/styayur/whinset/actions/runs/42263020010) | PASS | Actual Notepad3 fresh installation and AlreadyInstalled repeat on the actual hosted OS; [snapshot](evidence/rc2-package-ci.json) |
+| Independent interactive Windows 11 VM | BLOCKED | No connected disposable interactive environment; individual gates remain NOT RUN |
+
+The security regression covers identical/different SIDs, native denial classification, grant/deny/launch/crash/missing-result transport simulations, wrong/stale/replayed requests, modified graph/catalog and mismatched state. Recovery evidence covers repeated reconciliation, interrupted package execution, partial elevated phase, interrupted atomic state writes, reboot flags/boot-ID changes, package rechecks, concurrent apply rejection and inconsistent state rejection. These tests do not claim real UAC, power-loss durability or physical reboot acceptance.
+
+No privileged installer or system modification was run on the developer machine. Local writes were limited to source, build output and temporary test files/ACLs. The actual package installation occurred only in a disposable hosted runner.
+
+Outstanding independent acceptance is listed by every `RequiredForStable: true` matrix row and the [VM checklist](../../tests/VM-CHECKLIST.md): real same-user UAC grant/deny and different-user rejection; profile isolation; clean Windows 11 multi-package apply/idempotency; installer timeout/interruption; restart 3010/same-boot gate/post-boot continuation; WSL features, original-user registration and first run; Docker machine install, original-user first run and hello-world; actual published-bootstrap download/apply; vendor uninstall/manual recovery. Retain commands, both SIDs, boot IDs, state/JSONL logs, VM snapshot identity and independent reviewer sign-off. Keep [Issue #8](https://github.com/styayur/whinset/issues/8) open.

 - User data overwritten outside Whinset's recorded operation
 
 Whinset records what it attempted; it does not claim universal rollback.
+
+## RC.2 reconciliation and trust failures
+
+Different-user UAC credentials are unsupported. Retry from the intended account using same-user elevation; never use the alternate administrator's profile as a substitute. A launch failure/crash or invalid/missing worker result is a failure, not UAC denial. Review the structured elevation events and process/native error codes.
+
+Every package is rechecked against exact identity before execution, including prior successes in a partial run. Before a second installer attempt, inventory is checked again to avoid duplicating an installation that completed despite a transport interruption. A partial elevated phase retains completed records; interrupted/failed work becomes pending. Restart flags are cleared after a boot-ID change and prerequisites are re-evaluated. Do not manually clear a same-boot reboot gate to continue.
+
+Atomic writes preserve the previous committed file as `.bak`; an orphan `.tmp-*` is not authoritative. Corrupt JSON and mismatched identity/operation metadata fail closed. Preserve the main file, backup, temporary files and JSONL logs before manual inspection. There is no automatic backup promotion, state repair or power-loss durability guarantee. After resolving installer state manually, use a fresh private state directory if the old state cannot be trusted.
+
+Existing directories with foreign writers/owners or reparse paths are rejected. Inspect ACLs manually; Whinset does not take ownership or weaken access controls. Nonce-consumption markers remain under the run directory to reject replay. A new retry creates a fresh nonce; do not remove a marker to replay an old request.
+
+RC.1 plans include a different version identity and cannot be forced through RC.2 recovery. Preserve their state/logs, run a fresh RC.2 plan and reconcile actual installed packages. No package uninstall or rollback is performed by this transition.

+# Whinset v2.0.0-rc.2
+
+Release candidate only. Stable remains prohibited pending independent real Windows 11 acceptance. Roadmap Issue #8 remains open.
+
+## Read before download
+
+Whinset can install exact catalog packages, enable Windows features, update the machine WSL runtime, install Docker Desktop and change machine JAVA_HOME/PATH. Original-user work includes package/user environment configuration, WSL distribution registration and Docker daemon/hello-world verification. Installers may modify services, registry, startup entries, PATH and files beyond Whinset's state records. Review the plan and licenses before `apply -AcceptAgreements`.
+
+Normal Windows UAC is required when elevated work remains. Different-user UAC credentials are unsupported and rejected. Start from the intended account and use same-user elevation. No credentials are collected and UAC is never bypassed. No automatic reboot or rollback is implemented. Restart-required work exits 3010 and waits for a manual reboot. State/logs remain under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Whinset\v2`.
+
+## Changes since RC.1
+
+- Original/elevated SID policy, private run ACL validation and state identity/operation checks.
+- Native ERROR_CANCELLED (1223) classification; localized text no longer decides denial.
+- Expiring requests, atomic single-use nonce claims, result nonce/run/hash/process-exit validation and stricter trusted graph reconstruction.
+- Fixed the worker entrypoint to call its private function inside module scope.
+- Separated machine WSL updates from original-user distribution registration, and Docker machine installation from original-user daemon/smoke checks.
+- Rechecked interrupted installers before retry and successful packages during reconciliation; cleared reboot flags only after a boot-ID change.
+- PowerShell remains the execution core. CMD remains official; Git Bash and Nushell are experimental forwarding adapters. UTF-8 JSON stdout and human-error stderr are tested across shells.
+- Added security/recovery, shell, static-analysis, catalog/module, reproducibility and SHA-256 CI with machine-readable evidence. Added an actual disposable-runner package component install/recheck.
+
+## Evidence and limits
+
+Runtime evidence at `3d2af4ca538559d7023f8ed16a2dce17f614e9a2`:
+
+- PowerShell 5.1 and 7 CI passed legacy, Whinset and hardening suites; the hardening suite has 19 deterministic checks on each host.
+- Read-only CI shell tests passed for PowerShell 5.1/7, CMD and Git Bash. Nushell was unavailable in hosted CI; local Nushell 0.116.1 passed alongside the other shells (21 local checks including module validation).
+- A fresh Notepad3 installation and repeated AlreadyInstalled verification actually passed on a disposable hosted Windows runner. This is package-component evidence, not Windows 11 CLI/UAC/reboot certification.
+- Real UAC approval/denial, different-user credential rejection, clean Windows 11 multi-package apply, reboot continuation, WSL original-user first run, Docker first run/hello-world and vendor manual recovery are NOT RUN.
+
+See `acceptance-matrix.json`, `docs/acceptance/windows-v2.0.0-rc.2.json` and `tests/VM-CHECKLIST.md`. PASS for deterministic orchestration does not certify the corresponding interactive test. BLOCKED means the required interactive environment is unavailable; it does not mean the test passed.
+
+## Assets and recovery
+
+`Whinset-v2.0.0-rc.2.zip`, `beatwin.txt` and `acceptance-matrix.json` are covered by `SHA256SUMS.txt`. The archive has fixed ZIP metadata and normalized text; rebuilding the same tree must yield the same SHA-256. The bootstrap pins only the RC.2 release URL/hash and defaults to plan mode. +| Shell | Support | Invocation | Coverage |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| PowerShell 7 | Official | `pwsh -NoProfile -File ./whinset.ps1 version -Json` | Windows CI and local |
+| Windows PowerShell 5.1 | Official | `powershell.exe -NoProfile -File ./whinset.ps1 version -Json` | Windows CI and local |
+| CMD | Official | `whinset.cmd version -Json` | Windows CI and local |
+| Git Bash | Experimental | `bash ./whinset.sh version -Json` | Required Windows CI and local |
+| Nushell | Experimental | `nu --no-config-file ./whinset.nu version -Json` | Local when installed; CI records NOT RUN when unavailable |
+
+CMD, Git Bash and Nushell adapters prefer `pwsh.exe`, falling back to `powershell.exe`. They contain argument forwarding only. They do not implement package installation. Use Git for Windows Bash; WSL Bash is a different environment and is not supported by this adapter.

+whinset.cmd plan -ConfigPath "C:\reviewed files\packages.json" -Offline -Json

Offline planning is read-only. These tests do not run installers, UAC, reboots or first-run initialization. Shell metacharacters still follow the invoking shell's quoting rules; there is no promise that unquoted `%`, `$`, `&` or similar syntax is literal. release: prepare RC.2 with explicit Windows acceptance gates (#17)

Prepares v2.0.0-rc.2 source, reproducible assets, pinned bootstrap,
SHA-256 manifest and machine-readable acceptance matrix. Updates
architecture/security/recovery/CLI/shell documentation and the
independent Windows 11 VM checklist.

Includes evidence snapshots from passing PowerShell 5.1/7, shell,
static/catalog/module and reproducibility CI plus a genuine
disposable-runner Notepad3 install/recheck. Deterministic and read-only
evidence is explicitly distinguished from unexecuted interactive UAC,
reboot, WSL and Docker acceptance. Issue #8 remains open; no rollback is
claimed.

Release automation now prepares a draft prerelease, rejects Stable
publication and refuses to rebuild/replace published RC.1. The matrix
supports PASS, FAIL, NOT RUN, BLOCKED and NOT APPLICABLE. Final PR CI
verifies the pinned bootstrap and rebuilds the archive twice.

Local PS5.1 and PS7 Whinset suites: 28/28 each. Local double-build and
bootstrap verification passed. Stack: #15 -> #16 -> this PR. No
privileged installation or system modification occurred on the developer
machine.

---------

Co-authored-by: styayur <styayur@users.noreply.github.com>

 Read this before running `beatwin.txt` or changing `WhinsetMode` from `plan` to `apply`.

 - Installers can change files, services, startup entries, PATH, registry values and other machine state beyond Whinset's own operation records.
 - UAC is used through normal Windows elevation. Whinset does not disable UAC, collect credentials, use hidden elevation tricks, or pass arbitrary PowerShell code to the elevated process.
 - A non-elevated `apply` requests **one UAC authorization** when elevated work remains. All elevated operations then run in one validated worker.
 - If UAC is declined, the elevated phase stops with exit code **4**. The non-elevated planning/state files remain intact; no privileged installer was started by that phase.
+- Different-user UAC credentials are unsupported and rejected before elevated operations. User work remains in the intended original account.
 - Logs and structured state are stored under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Whinset\v2`.
 - Packages can normally be removed with an exact WinGet uninstall, but some installer changes remain manual. Windows features, WSL distributions, Docker first-run state, registry edits and vendor services must be reviewed individually. **Whinset does not claim automatic rollback.**
 - There is no promise that uninstalling a package restores every PATH, service, registry or application setting that its installer changed.
 - Restart may be required. Whinset never restarts Windows automatically.

+# RC.2 acceptance evidence
+
+Date: 2026-11-07 (Asia/Singapore). Decision: RC.2 only; Stable is not eligible.
+
+The [machine-readable matrix](windows-v2.0.0-rc.2.json) distinguishes PASS, FAIL, NOT RUN, BLOCKED and NOT APPLICABLE. Each PASS identifies its evidence scope. It records the tested runtime revision; later release metadata/version preparation is verified by the release-preparation PR CI.
+
+| Evidence | Result | Scope |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| [PowerShell CI](https://github.com/styayur/whinset/actions/runs/42263019789) | PASS | PowerShell 5.1 and 7 legacy/Whinset/hardening suites; static analysis, catalog/module checks and reproducible builds |
+| [Hosted shell snapshot](evidence/rc2-shells-ci.json) | 17 PASS; Nushell NOT RUN | Real read-only CLI invocation: PS5.1, PS7, CMD, Git Bash and module checks |
+| [Local shell snapshot](evidence/rc2-shells-local.json) | 21 PASS | Same read-only checks plus Nushell 0.116.1 |
+| [Hardening PS5.1](evidence/rc2-hardening-ps51.json) / [PS7](evidence/rc2-hardening-ps7.json) | 19 PASS each | Simulated UAC/transport/operations; actual temporary state-file/ACL I/O |
+| [Disposable package integration](https://github.com/styayur/whinset/actions/runs/42263020010) | PASS | Actual Notepad3 fresh installation and AlreadyInstalled repeat on the actual hosted OS; [snapshot](evidence/rc2-package-ci.json) |
+| Independent interactive Windows 11 VM | BLOCKED | No connected disposable interactive environment; individual gates remain NOT RUN |
+
+The security regression covers identical/different SIDs, native denial classification, grant/deny/launch/crash/missing-result transport simulations, wrong/stale/replayed requests, modified graph/catalog and mismatched state. Recovery evidence covers repeated reconciliation, interrupted package execution, partial elevated phase, interrupted atomic state writes, reboot flags/boot-ID changes, package rechecks, concurrent apply rejection and inconsistent state rejection. These tests do not claim real UAC, power-loss durability or physical reboot acceptance.
+
+No privileged installer or system modification was run on the developer machine. Local writes were limited to source, build output and temporary test files/ACLs. The actual package installation occurred only in a disposable hosted runner.

+# Whinset v2.0.0-rc.2
+
+Release candidate only. Stable remains prohibited pending independent real Windows 11 acceptance. Roadmap Issue #8 remains open.
+
+## Read before download
+
+Whinset can install exact catalog packages, enable Windows features, update the machine WSL runtime, install Docker Desktop and change machine JAVA_HOME/PATH. Original-user work includes package/user environment configuration, WSL distribution registration and Docker daemon/hello-world verification. Installers may modify services, registry, startup entries, PATH and files beyond Whinset's state records. Review the plan and licenses before `apply -AcceptAgreements`.
+
+Normal Windows UAC is required when elevated work remains. Different-user UAC credentials are unsupported and rejected. Start from the intended account and use same-user elevation. No credentials are collected and UAC is never bypassed. No automatic reboot or rollback is implemented. Restart-required work exits 3010 and waits for a manual reboot. State/logs remain under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Whinset\v2`.
+
+## Changes since RC.1
+
+- Original/elevated SID policy, private run ACL validation and state identity/operation checks.
+- Native ERROR_CANCELLED (1223) classification; localized text no longer decides denial.
+- Expiring requests, atomic single-use nonce claims, result nonce/run/hash/process-exit validation and stricter trusted graph reconstruction.
+- Fixed the worker entrypoint to call its private function inside module scope.
+- Separated machine WSL updates from original-user distribution registration, and Docker machine installation from original-user daemon/smoke checks.
+- Rechecked interrupted installers before retry and successful packages during reconciliation; cleared reboot flags only after a boot-ID change.
+- PowerShell remains the execution core. CMD remains official; Git Bash and Nushell are experimental forwarding adapters. UTF-8 JSON stdout and human-error stderr are tested across shells.
+- Added security/recovery, shell, static-analysis, catalog/module, reproducibility and SHA-256 CI with machine-readable evidence. Added an actual disposable-runner package component install/recheck.
+
+## Evidence and limits
+
+Runtime evidence at `3d2af4ca538559d7023f8ed16a2dce17f614e9a2`:
+
+- PowerShell 5.1 and 7 CI passed legacy, Whinset and hardening suites; the hardening suite has 19 deterministic checks on each host.
+- Read-only CI shell tests passed for PowerShell 5.1/7, CMD and Git Bash. Nushell was unavailable in hosted CI; local Nushell 0.116.1 passed alongside the other shells (21 local checks including module validation).
+- A fresh Notepad3 installation and repeated AlreadyInstalled verification actually passed on a disposable hosted Windows runner. This is package-component evidence, not Windows 11 CLI/UAC/reboot certification.
+- Real UAC approval/denial, different-user credential rejection, clean Windows 11 multi-package apply, reboot continuation, WSL original-user first run, Docker first run/hello-world and vendor manual recovery are NOT RUN.
+
+See `acceptance-matrix.json`, `docs/acceptance/windows-v2.0.0-rc.2.json` and `tests/VM-CHECKLIST.md`. PASS for deterministic orchestration does not certify the corresponding interactive test. BLOCKED means the required interactive environment is unavailable; it does not mean the test passed.
+
+## Assets and recovery
+
+`Whinset-v2.0.0-rc.2.zip`, `beatwin.txt` and `acceptance-matrix.json` are covered by `SHA256SUMS.txt`. The archive has fixed ZIP metadata and normalized text; rebuilding the same tree must yield the same SHA-256. The bootstrap pins only the RC.2 release URL/hash and defaults to plan mode. A draft asset URL becomes downloadable only after the RC.2 prerelease is published.
+
+Published RC.1 tag/assets are preserved. RC.2 changes the plan identity; inspect old RC.1 state/logs and create a fresh RC.2 plan to reconcile installed packages. Do not rewrite an RC.1 plan hash to force recovery. Foreign-writable or inconsistent state is rejected for manual inspection. Request markers and atomic-write backups are retained as evidence. No automatic rollback is claimed.
+
+Exit codes remain: 0 complete, 1 operation/worker failure, 2 input/agreement error, 3 compatibility cancellation, 4 UAC denied, 5 doctor unhealthy, 3010 restart required. Native/process diagnostics remain in structured logs.

 ## Logs
 
 Structured logs are stored under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Whinset\v2\runs\<plan-hash>\operations.jsonl`. Review them before sharing; they can contain machine paths, package IDs and installer output.
+
+## RC.2 identity and request policy
+
+Different-user UAC credentials are unsupported in RC.2. The worker rejects a SID mismatch before claiming a request, writing results/state, or running operations. Use same-user elevation from the intended account. Starting the whole CLI as another administrator makes that administrator the original user; Whinset cannot infer a previous desktop account. There is no credential collection or token impersonation.
+
+The original process performs user package installs, WSL default-version/distribution registration and Docker daemon/hello-world checks. The elevated phase enables Windows features, updates the machine WSL runtime and installs machine-scoped Docker Desktop. Docker first-run initialization remains a manual original-user action when the daemon is unavailable. Package scope `auto` follows the catalog/vendor installer; because different-user elevation is rejected, it cannot silently target a different administrator profile. It is not a guarantee that every vendor installer supports machine scope.
+
+Run directories are protected with inheritable full-control entries only for the original SID, SYSTEM and Administrators. Existing directories/files with foreign writers or owners are rejected, as are state paths containing reparse points. Existing RC.1 state with unsuitable ACLs requires manual inspection and a new private state directory; Whinset does not silently take ownership. State identity and operation metadata must match the reconstructed graph.
+
+Requests expire after ten minutes (future timestamps beyond 30 seconds are rejected). A unique nonce is claimed with CreateNew before operation execution; a second use is rejected. Every retry creates a new request/nonce. Results bind the nonce, run ID, plan hash and process exit code. Only native ERROR_CANCELLED (1223), including wrapped Win32 exceptions, means UAC denial; launch failures and crashes remain failures with structured diagnostic events. The worker requires an administrator token and is invoked inside private module scope.
+
+Plan hashes, ACLs and nonces detect inconsistent inputs; they are not a signature or a security boundary against the same Windows user or administrators. The installed scripts and catalog must be reviewed/trusted together before UAC. This portable release does not protect a user-writable checkout from a same-user process changing code before elevation. Do not elevate a checkout supplied by another account. No claim of interactive UAC acceptance follows from deterministic tests.

+# Shell compatibility
+
+PowerShell is the single execution core. `-Json` is the machine-readable interface. JSON uses UTF-8 stdout, including Windows PowerShell 5.1. Human command errors use stderr; JSON errors remain a single stdout object. Callers must also check the process exit code.
+
+| Shell | Support | Invocation | Coverage |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| PowerShell 7 | Official | `pwsh -NoProfile -File ./whinset.ps1 version -Json` | Windows CI and local |
+| Windows PowerShell 5.1 | Official | `powershell.exe -NoProfile -File ./whinset.ps1 version -Json` | Windows CI and local |
+| CMD | Official | `whinset.cmd version -Json` | Windows CI and local |
+| Git Bash | Experimental | `bash ./whinset.sh version -Json` | Required Windows CI and local |
+| Nushell | Experimental | `nu --no-config-file ./whinset.nu version -Json` | Local when installed; CI records NOT RUN when unavailable |
+
+CMD, Git Bash and Nushell adapters prefer `pwsh.exe`, falling back to `powershell.exe`. They contain argument forwarding only. They do not implement package installation. Use Git for Windows Bash; WSL Bash is a different environment and is not supported by this adapter.
+
+Examples of literal, single arguments:
+
+```cmd
+whinset.cmd plan -ConfigPath "C:\reviewed files\packages.json" -Offline -Json
+```
+
+```bash
+bash ./whinset.sh resolve 'Google Chrome' -Json
+```
+
+```nu
+nu --no-config-file ./whinset.nu resolve 'Google Chrome' -Json | from json
+```
+
+The test suite copies the real CLI under a directory containing spaces and Unicode. It checks JSON parsing, a literal argument containing Unicode, spaces, embedded quotes and a trailing backslash, human stderr, invalid-input exit 2 and successful exit 0. Offline planning is read-only. These tests do not run installers, UAC, reboots or first-run initialization. Shell metacharacters still follow the invoking shell's quoting rules; there is no promise that unquoted `%`, `$`, `&` or similar syntax is literal. For PowerShell array parameters, use native PowerShell/module invocation; other shells should use one selector per invocation or a reviewed profile.
+
+Run `./tests/Run-ShellTests.ps1 -RequireGitBash -EvidencePath <absolute-json-path>` to generate evidence. `-RequireNushell` turns a missing Nushell executable into FAIL. Evidence statuses are PASS, FAIL or NOT RUN; the release acceptance matrix additionally supports BLOCKED and NOT APPLICABLE.

+function Assert-WhinsetSameUser {
+    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$OriginalUserSid, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$CurrentUserSid)
+    if ($OriginalUserSid -ne $CurrentUserSid) {
+        throw 'Different-user UAC credentials are unsupported. No worker operations were started. Run as the intended user with same-user elevation.'
+    }
+}
+
+function Assert-WhinsetStateMatchesPlan {
+    param([Parameter(Mandatory)]$State, [Parameter(Mandatory)]$Plan)
+    if ($State.PlanHash -ne $Plan.PlanHash -or $State.RunId -ne $Plan.RunId -or $State.OriginalUserSid -ne $Plan.Environment.UserSid -or $State.MachineIdentity.ComputerName -ne $Plan.Environment.ComputerName) { throw 'State identity does not match the plan.' }
+    $expected = @($Plan.Operations.Id | Sort-Object)
+    $actual = @($State.Operations.Id | Sort-Object)
+    if (($expected -join "`n") -cne ($actual -join "`n")) { throw 'State operations do not match the plan.' }
+    foreach ($record in $State.Operations) {
+        $operation = @($Plan.Operations | Where-Object { $_.Id -eq $record.Id })[0]
+        if ($record.Kind -ne $operation.Kind -or $record.Privilege -ne $operation.Privilege -or $record.Status -notin @('Pending','Running','Succeeded','AlreadyInstalled','Skipped','Warning','Failed','AwaitingReboot','Blocked')) { throw 'State operation metadata is inconsistent.' }
+    }
+}
+
+function Assert-WhinsetPrivatePath {
+    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$UserSid)
+    $full = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
+    $cursor = $full
+    while ($cursor) {
+        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cursor) {
+            $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $cursor -Force
+            if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "Reparse points are unsupported in state paths: $cursor" }
+        }
+        $cursor = Split-Path $cursor -Parent
+    }
+    $acl = Get-Acl -LiteralPath $full
+    $allowed = @($UserSid,'S-1-5-18','S-1-5-32-544')
+    if ($acl.GetOwner([Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]).Value -notin $allowed) { throw "Untrusted state owner: $full" }
+    $writeMask = [Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]'Write,Modify,FullControl,Delete,ChangePermissions,TakeOwnership'
+    foreach ($rule in $acl.GetAccessRules($true,$true,[Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier])) {
+        if ($rule.AccessControlType -eq 'Allow' -and ($rule.FileSystemRights -band $writeMask) -and $rule.IdentityReference.Value -notin $allowed) { throw "State path grants another principal write access: $full" }
+    }
+}
+
+function Initialize-WhinsetPrivateRunDirectory {
+    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path)
+    $sid = [string](Get-WhinsetMachineIdentity).UserSid
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) {
+        # Check existing ancestors before creation, then remove inherited access on the new run.
+        $cursor = Split-Path ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)) -Parent
+        while ($cursor) {
+            if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $cursor) -and ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $cursor -Force).Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { throw 'Reparse points are unsupported in state paths.' }
+            $cursor = Split-Path $cursor -Parent
+        }
+        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null
+        $acl = New-Object Security.AccessControl.DirectorySecurity
+        $acl.SetAccessRuleProtection($true,$false)
+        $acl.SetOwner((New-Object Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier($sid)))
+        foreach ($principal in @($sid,'S-1-5-18','S-1-5-32-544')) {
+            $identity = New-Object Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier($principal)
+            $rule = New-Object Security.AccessControl.FileSystemAccessRule($identity,'FullControl','ContainerInherit,ObjectInherit','None','Allow')
+            $acl.AddAccessRule($rule)
+        }
+        Set-Acl -LiteralPath $Path -AclObject $acl
+    }
+    Assert-WhinsetPrivatePath -Path $Path -UserSid $sid
+}
+
+function Get-WhinsetNativeErrorCode {
+    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][Exception]$Exception)
+    $current = $Exception

+#requires -Version 5.1
+param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$EvidencePath)
+# Real component integration, restricted to disposable GitHub-hosted environments.
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
+if ($env:GITHUB_ACTIONS -ne 'true' -or $env:RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT -ne 'github-hosted') { throw 'This installer test is restricted to disposable GitHub-hosted runners.' }
+$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
+Import-Module (Join-Path $root 'src/Whinset.psd1') -Force
+& (Get-Module Whinset) {
+    param($Root,$EvidencePath)
+    $environment = Get-WhinsetEnvironmentSnapshot
+    $plan = New-WhinsetPlan -CatalogPath (Join-Path $Root 'config/packages.json') -Profile Minimal -Package Notepad3 -Offline -Environment $environment
+    $paths = Get-WhinsetRunPaths -StateRoot (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'real-package-state') -PlanHash $plan.PlanHash
+    Initialize-WhinsetPrivateRunDirectory $paths.RunDirectory
+    $state = New-WhinsetRunState $plan $environment $paths
+    $operation = @($plan.Operations | Where-Object PackageKey -eq Notepad3)[0]
+    # No synthetic Windows 11 environment: exercise the package component on the actual runner OS.
+    $package = [pscustomobject]@{ Key=$operation.PackageKey; Id=$operation.PackageId; Source=$operation.Source; Architecture=$operation.Architecture; Scope=$operation.Scope; Version=$operation.Version; VersionPolicy=$operation.VersionPolicy }
+    $before = Test-WhinsetPackageInstalled $package -AcceptAgreements
+    if ($before.Installed) { throw 'Notepad3 already exists; this run cannot prove a fresh installation.' }
+    $first = Invoke-WhinsetPackageOperation $plan $state $operation $paths
+    $second = Invoke-WhinsetPackageOperation $plan $state $operation $paths
+    $evidence = [ordered]@{ SchemaVersion=1; Suite='real disposable package component integration'; Environment=$environment; Package=$package; First=$first; Repeated=$second; InteractiveUac='NOT RUN'; Reboot='NOT RUN'; Windows11CliAcceptance='NOT APPLICABLE'; RunUrl="https://github.com/$env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID" }
+    Write-WhinsetJsonFileAtomically $EvidencePath $evidence
+    if ($first.Status -ne 'Succeeded' -or $second.Status -ne 'AlreadyInstalled') { throw 'Fresh installation or repeated package verification failed; inspect evidence.' }
+} $root $EvidencePath

+#requires -Version 5.1
+param([string]$EvidencePath = '')
+# Deterministic security/recovery tests. UAC and operation execution are simulated.
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
+$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
+$script:WhinsetRoot = $root
+. (Join-Path $root 'src/Configuration.ps1')
+. (Join-Path $root 'src/SetupNewPC.Core.ps1')
+Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $root 'src/Whinset') -Filter '*.ps1' | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { . $_.FullName }
+$testRoot = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('Whinset-hardening-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
+$results = New-Object Collections.Generic.List[object]
+function Assert($Value, [string]$Message = 'Assertion failed') { if (-not $Value) { throw $Message } }
+function Reject([scriptblock]$Action, [string]$Pattern = '*') {
+    $caught = $false
+    try { & $Action | Out-Null } catch { $caught = $true; Assert ($_.Exception.Message -like $Pattern) "Unexpected error: $_" }
+    Assert $caught 'Expected rejection'
+}
+function Test([string]$Name, [scriptblock]$Action) {
+    try { & $Action; $results.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Name=$Name; Status='PASS'; Detail='' }); Write-Output "PASS $Name" }
+    catch { $results.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Name=$Name; Status='FAIL'; Detail=[string]$_ }); Write-Output "FAIL $Name : $_ $($_.ScriptStackTrace)" }
+}
+$sid = [string](Get-WhinsetMachineIdentity).UserSid
+$environment = [pscustomobject]@{
+    Caption='Windows 11 deterministic fixture'; OsVersion='10.0.26100'; BuildNumber=26100; ProductType=1; IsWindows11=$true
+    PowerShellVersion='5.1'; PowerShellEdition='Desktop'; Is64BitProcess=$true; Architecture='x64'
+    IsAdministrator=$false; ComputerName=$env:COMPUTERNAME; UserSid=$sid
+    UserProfile=$env:USERPROFILE; LocalAppData=$env:LOCALAPPDATA; Temp=$testRoot
+    WingetAvailable=$true; WingetVersion='1.9.0'; WingetVersionOk=$true; PendingReboot=@(); Blockers=@(); Warnings=@(); BootId='boot-1'
+}
+$plan = New-WhinsetPlan -CatalogPath (Join-Path $root 'config/packages.json') -Profile Minimal -Offline -Environment $environment
+function Fixture {
+    $context = Get-WhinsetRunContext -Plan $plan -Environment $environment -StateRoot (Join-Path $testRoot ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')))
+    $request = [pscustomobject]@{ SchemaVersion=1; RunId=$plan.RunId; PlanHash=$plan.PlanHash; PlanPath=$context.Paths.PlanPath; Nonce=[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'); OriginalUserSid=$sid; CreatedAt=Get-WhinsetTimestamp }
+    Write-WhinsetJsonFileAtomically $context.Paths.ElevationRequestPath $request
+    return [pscustomobject]@{ Context=$context; Request=$request }
+}
+# Only this token probe and the actual operation executor are simulated for worker tests.
+function Test-WhinsetIsAdministrator { return $true }
+$script:executed = 0
+function Invoke-WhinsetOperationInternal { param($Plan,$State,$Operation,$Paths)
+    $script:executed++; New-WhinsetOperationResult -Status Succeeded -ExitCode 0 }
+try {
+    Test 'SID policy accepts identical SIDs and rejects different-user credentials' {
+        Assert-WhinsetSameUser 'S-1-5-21-1' 'S-1-5-21-1'
+        Reject { Assert-WhinsetSameUser 'S-1-5-21-1' 'S-1-5-21-2' } '*Different-user*'
+    }
+    Test 'Native cancellation uses ERROR_CANCELLED 1223 independent of language' {
+        Assert ((Get-WhinsetNativeErrorCode (New-Object ComponentModel.Win32Exception(1223,'Zugriff'))) -eq 1223)
+        Assert ((Get-WhinsetNativeErrorCode (New-Object Exception('cancelled'))) -eq $null)
+        Assert ((Get-WhinsetNativeErrorCode (New-Object Exception('wrapped',(New-Object ComponentModel.Win32Exception(5))))) -eq 5)
+    }
+    Test 'Private state directory and inherited file ACLs reject foreign writers' {
+        $f = Fixture
+        Assert-WhinsetPrivatePath $f.Context.Paths.StatePath $sid
+        $acl = Get-Acl $f.Context.Paths.StatePath
+        $foreign = New-Object Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier('S-1-1-0')
+        $acl.AddAccessRule((New-Object Security.AccessControl.FileSystemAccessRule($foreign,'Write','Allow')))
+        Set-Acl $f.Context.Paths.StatePath $acl
+        Reject { Assert-WhinsetPrivatePath $f.Context.Paths.StatePath $sid } '*write access*'
+    }
+    Test 'Worker grant simulation executes once and rejects replay' {
+        $f = Fixture; $script:executed = 0
+        $r = Invoke-WhinsetElevatedWorker $f.Context.Paths.PlanPath $plan.PlanHash $f.Request.Nonce
+        Assert ($r.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $r.Nonce -eq $f.Request.Nonce)
+        Assert ($script:executed -eq $plan.Operations.Count)
+        Reject { Invoke-WhinsetElevatedWorker $f.Context.Paths.PlanPath $plan.PlanHash $f.Request.Nonce } '*already exists*'
+        Assert ($script:executed -eq $plan.Operations.Count)
+    }
+    Test 'Worker rejects wrong nonce without result writes' {
+        $f = Fixture
+        Reject { Invoke-WhinsetElevatedWorker $f.Context.Paths.PlanPath $plan.PlanHash ('a' * 32) } '*nonce*'
+        Assert (-not (Test-Path $f.Context.Paths.ElevatedResultPath))
+    }
+    Test 'Worker rejects stale and future requests' {
+        foreach ($minutes in @(-11,2)) {
+            $f = Fixture; $f.Request.CreatedAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddMinutes($minutes).ToString('o')
+            Write-WhinsetJsonFileAtomically $f.Context.Paths.ElevationRequestPath $f.Request
+            Reject { Invoke-WhinsetElevatedWorker $f.Context.Paths.PlanPath $plan.PlanHash $f.Request.Nonce } '*stale*'
+        }
+    }
+    Test 'Worker rejects alternate-user request and mismatched state' {
+        $f = Fixture; $f.Request.OriginalUserSid = 'S-1-5-21-OTHER'
+        Write-WhinsetJsonFileAtomically $f.Context.Paths.ElevationRequestPath $f.Request
+        Reject { Invoke-WhinsetElevatedWorker $f.Context.Paths.PlanPath $plan.PlanHash $f.Request.Nonce } '*identity*'
+        $f = Fixture; $f.Context.State.Operations[0].Privilege = 'user'
+        Save-WhinsetRunState $f.Context.State $f.Context.Paths
+        Reject { Invoke-WhinsetElevatedWorker $f.Context.Paths.PlanPath $plan.PlanHash $f.Request.Nonce } '*metadata*'
+    }
+    Test 'Trusted reconstruction rejects modified executable plan and catalog hash' {
+        $f = Fixture; $stored = Read-WhinsetJsonFile $f.Context.Paths.PlanPath
+        $stored.Operations[0].Scope = 'user'
+        Write-WhinsetJsonFileAtomically $f.Context.Paths.PlanPath $stored
+        Reject { Get-WhinsetTrustedPlan $f.Context.Paths.PlanPath $plan.PlanHash } '*graph differs*'
+        $stored.Identity.Catalog.Sha256 = '0' * 64
+        Write-WhinsetJsonFileAtomically $f.Context.Paths.PlanPath $stored
+        Reject { Get-WhinsetTrustedPlan $f.Context.Paths.PlanPath $plan.PlanHash } '*catalog hash*'
+    }
+    Test 'WSL and Docker graphs isolate machine and original-user operations' {
+        $p = New-WhinsetPlan -CatalogPath (Join-Path $root 'config/packages.json') -Profile Minimal -EnableDocker -Offline -Environment $environment
+        foreach ($id in @('system:wsl-features','system:wsl-runtime','system:docker')) { Assert ((@($p.Operations | Where-Object Id -eq $id)[0]).Privilege -eq 'elevated') }
+        foreach ($id in @('user:wsl-distribution','user:docker-verify')) { Assert ((@($p.Operations | Where-Object Id -eq $id)[0]).Privilege -eq 'user') }
+        Assert ((@($p.Operations | Where-Object Id -eq 'system:docker')[0]).Scope -eq 'machine')
+    }
+    Test 'Interrupted state replacement preserves old valid JSON and backup' {
+        $f = Fixture; $path = $f.Context.Paths.StatePath
+        [IO.File]::WriteAllText(($path + '.tmp-interrupted'),'{')
+        Assert ((Read-WhinsetRunState $path).PlanHash -eq $plan.PlanHash)
+        $f.Context.State.Detail = 'new committed value'
+        Save-WhinsetRunState $f.Context.State $f.Context.Paths
+        Assert ((Read-WhinsetRunState $path).Detail -eq 'new committed value')
+        Assert ((Read-WhinsetRunState ($path + '.bak')).PlanHash -eq $plan.PlanHash)
+    }
+    Test 'Partial elevated phase resumes pending work and preserves successes' {
+        $f = Fixture
+        $f.Context.State.Operations[0].Status = 'Succeeded'
+        $f.Context.State.Operations[1].Status = 'Running'
+        Save-WhinsetRunState $f.Context.State $f.Context.Paths
+        $c = Get-WhinsetRunContext $plan $environment $f.Context.Paths.StateRoot
+        Assert ($c.State.Operations[0].Status -eq 'Succeeded')
+        Assert ($c.State.Operations[1].Status -eq 'Pending')
+        $c.State.Operations = @($c.State.Operations | Select-Object -Skip 1)
+        Save-WhinsetRunState $c.State $c.Paths
+        Reject { Get-WhinsetRunContext $plan $environment $c.Paths.StateRoot } '*operations do not match*'
+    }
+    Test 'Interrupted installer is rechecked before another install attempt' {
+        $f = Fixture; $script:probes = 0; $script:installs = 0
+        function Test-WhinsetPackageInstalled {
+            param($Package,[switch]$AcceptAgreements)
+            $script:probes++
+            [pscustomobject]@{ Installed=($script:probes -gt 1); VersionVerified=$true; Error=''; ExitCode=0 }
+        }
+        function Invoke-WhinsetExternalCommand { param($FilePath,$ArgumentList,$TimeoutSeconds)
+            $script:installs++; throw 'Installer transport interrupted after launch' }
+        $operation = $plan.Operations[0]
+        $r = Invoke-WhinsetPackageOperation $plan $f.Context.State $operation $f.Context.Paths
+        Assert ($r.Status -eq 'AlreadyInstalled' -and $script:installs -eq 1)
+    }
+    Test 'Repeated apply package recheck detects removed package after success' {
+        $f = Fixture
+        foreach ($op in $f.Context.State.Operations) { $op.Status = 'Succeeded' }
+        function Test-WhinsetPackageInstalled { param($Package,[switch]$AcceptAgreements)
+            [pscustomobject]@{ Installed=$false; VersionVerified=$false; Error=''; ExitCode=0 } }
+        Invoke-WhinsetPackagePreflightRecheck $plan $f.Context.State $f.Context.Paths
+        Assert (@($f.Context.State.Operations | Where-Object Status -eq Pending).Count -eq $plan.Operations.Count)
+    }
+    # Launch transport simulation exercises the real parent elevation function, never RunAs.
+    $script:launchMode = 'grant'
+    function Start-Process {
+        param($FilePath,$ArgumentList,$Verb,$WindowStyle,[switch]$Wait,[switch]$PassThru,$ErrorAction)
+        if ($script:launchMode -eq 'deny') { throw (New-Object ComponentModel.Win32Exception(1223,'Localized text')) }
+        if ($script:launchMode -eq 'launch-failure') { throw (New-Object ComponentModel.Win32Exception(2)) }
+        if ($script:launchMode -in @('crash','missing')) { return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode=$(if ($script:launchMode -eq 'crash') { 42 } else { 0 }) } }
+        $req = Read-WhinsetJsonFile $script:launchPaths.ElevationRequestPath
+        $nonce = $req.Nonce
+        if ($script:launchMode -eq 'wrong-nonce') { $nonce = '0' * 32 }
+        $r = [pscustomobject]@{ SchemaVersion=1; RunId=$plan.RunId; PlanHash=$plan.PlanHash; Nonce=$nonce; ExitCode=0; Error='' }
+        Write-WhinsetJsonFileAtomically $script:launchPaths.ElevatedResultPath $r
+        return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode=0 }
+    }
+    foreach ($mode in @('grant','deny','launch-failure','crash','missing','wrong-nonce')) {
+        Test "Elevation transport simulation: $mode" {
+            $f = Fixture; $script:launchPaths = $f.Context.Paths; $script:launchMode = $mode
+            $r = Invoke-WhinsetElevation $plan $script:launchPaths
+            if ($mode -eq 'grant') { Assert ($r.Granted -and $r.Result -and $r.ExitCode -eq 0) }
+            elseif ($mode -eq 'deny') { Assert ($r.Denied -and -not $r.Granted) }
+            elseif ($mode -eq 'launch-failure') { Assert (-not $r.Denied -and -not $r.Granted) }
+            else { Assert ($r.Granted -and -not $r.Result -and $r.Error); if ($mode -eq 'crash') { Assert ($r.ExitCode -eq 42) } }
+        }
+    }
+} finally {
+    if ($EvidencePath) { Write-WhinsetJsonFileAtomically $EvidencePath ([ordered]@{ SchemaVersion=1; Suite='deterministic hardening; simulated UAC and operations'; PowerShellVersion=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString(); Results=@($results.ToArray()) }) }
+    $resolved = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($testRoot)
+    $temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()).TrimEnd('\') + '\'
+    if ($resolved.StartsWith($temp,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -and (Split-Path $resolved -Leaf) -like 'Whinset-hardening-*') { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $resolved -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
+}
+$failed = @($results | Where-Object Status -eq 'FAIL').Count
+Write-Output "$($results.Count - $failed) passed; $failed failed"
+if ($failed) { exit 1 }
+exit 0

@@ -0,0 +1,100 @@
+#requires -Version 5.1
+param([string]$EvidencePath = '', [switch]$RequireGitBash, [switch]$RequireNushell)
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
+$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
+. (Join-Path $root 'src/SetupNewPC.Core.ps1')
+$testRoot = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('Whinset-shell-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
+$copy = Join-Path $testRoot ('space ' + [char]0x96ea)
+$results = New-Object Collections.Generic.List[object]
+$utf8 = New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
+function Assert($Value,[string]$Message) { if (-not $Value) { throw $Message } }
+function Quote-Bash([string]$Value) { return "'" + $Value.Replace("'", "'\''") + "'" }
+function Run-Shell($Shell, [string[]]$Arguments) {
+    $core = Join-Path $copy 'whinset.ps1'
+    switch ($Shell.Kind) {
+        'powershell' { return (Invoke-ExternalCommand $Shell.Path (@('-NoLogo','-NoProfile','-File',$core) + $Arguments)) }
+        'cmd' {
+            $command = '@echo off' + "`r`nchcp 65001 >nul`r`ncall " + (ConvertTo-NativeArgument (Join-Path $copy 'whinset.cmd')) + ' ' + (($Arguments | ForEach-Object { ConvertTo-NativeArgument $_ }) -join ' ') + "`r`nexit /b %errorlevel%`r`n"
+            $path = Join-Path $testRoot 'invoke.cmd'
+            [IO.File]::WriteAllText($path,$command,$utf8)
+            return (Invoke-ExternalCommand $Shell.Path @('/d','/c',$path))
+        }
+        'bash' {
+            $command = 'bash ' + (Quote-Bash ((Join-Path $copy 'whinset.sh').Replace('\','/'))) + ' ' + (($Arguments | ForEach-Object { Quote-Bash $_ }) -join ' ')
+            return (Invoke-ExternalCommand $Shell.Path @('--noprofile','--norc','-c',$command))
+        }
+        'nu' { return (Invoke-ExternalCommand $Shell.Path (@('--no-config-file',(Join-Path $copy 'whinset.nu')) + $Arguments)) }
+    }
+}
+try {
+    New-Item -ItemType Directory $copy -Force | Out-Null
+    foreach ($name in @('src','config','whinset.ps1','whinset.cmd','whinset.sh','whinset.nu')) { Copy-Item (Join-Path $root $name) $copy -Recurse }
+    $shells = @(
+        [pscustomobject]@{ Name='PowerShell 5.1'; Kind='powershell'; Path=(Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe'); Required=$true },
+        [pscustomobject]@{ Name='PowerShell 7'; Kind='powershell'; Path=(Get-Command pwsh.exe).Source; Required=$true },
+        [pscustomobject]@{ Name='CMD launcher'; Kind='cmd'; Path=$env:ComSpec; Required=$true }
+    )
+    $bash = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Git/bin/bash.exe'
+    $nu = Get-Command nu.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+    $shells += [pscustomobject]@{ Name='Git Bash adapter'; Kind='bash'; Path=$bash; Required=[bool]$RequireGitBash }
+    $shells += [pscustomobject]@{ Name='Nushell adapter'; Kind='nu'; Path=$(if ($nu) { $nu.Source } else { '' }); Required=[bool]$RequireNushell }
+    foreach ($shell in $shells) {
+        if (-not $shell.Path -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $shell.Path)) {
+            $status = if ($shell.Required) { 'FAIL' } else { 'NOT RUN' }
+            $results.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Shell=$shell.Name; Test='availability'; Status=$status; Detail='Executable unavailable' })
+            continue
+        }
+        foreach ($case in @('json-unicode-path','quoted-argument','stderr-and-exit','offline-plan')) {
+            try {
+                switch ($case) {
+                    'json-unicode-path' {
+                        $r = Run-Shell $shell @('version','-Json')
+                        Assert ($r.ExitCode -eq 0 -and -not $r.Error) "Exit $($r.ExitCode): $($r.Error) $($r.Output)"
+                        $json = $r.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
+                        Assert ($json.RepositoryRoot -eq $copy) 'Unicode/spaced repository path changed'
+                    }
+                    'quoted-argument' {
+                        $query = 'spaces ' + [char]0x96ea + ' "quoted" C:\tail\'
+                        $r = Run-Shell $shell @('resolve',$query,'-Json')
+                        Assert ($r.ExitCode -eq 2 -and -not $r.Error) "Exit $($r.ExitCode): $($r.Error) $($r.Output)"
+                        Assert (($r.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Query -ceq $query) "Argument changed: $($r.Output)"
+                    }
+                    'stderr-and-exit' {
+                        $r = Run-Shell $shell @('plan','-Profile','DoesNotExist','-Offline')
+                        Assert ($r.ExitCode -eq 2) "Expected exit 2, got $($r.ExitCode)"
+                        Assert (-not $r.Output -and $r.Error -like '*whinset:*') "Expected stderr only: $($r.Output) $($r.Error)"
+                    }
+                    'offline-plan' {
+                        $r = Run-Shell $shell @('plan','-Profile','Minimal','-Offline','-Json')
+                        Assert ($r.ExitCode -eq 0 -and -not $r.Error) "Exit $($r.ExitCode): $($r.Error) $($r.Output)"
+                        Assert (($r.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).SchemaVersion -eq 2) 'Invalid plan JSON'
+                    }
+                }
+                $results.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Shell=$shell.Name; Test=$case; Status='PASS'; Detail='' })
+                Write-Output "PASS $($shell.Name): $case"
+            } catch {
+                $results.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Shell=$shell.Name; Test=$case; Status='FAIL'; Detail=[string]$_ })
+                Write-Output "FAIL $($shell.Name): $case : $_"
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    Import-Module (Join-Path $copy 'src/Whinset.psd1') -Force
+    $exports = @((Get-Module Whinset).ExportedFunctions.Keys)
+    Assert ($exports.Count -eq 1 -and $exports[0] -eq 'Invoke-Whinset') 'Unexpected public module functions'
+    Assert ([bool](& (Get-Module Whinset) { Get-Command Invoke-WhinsetElevatedWorker -ErrorAction Stop })) 'Private worker entrypoint unavailable'
+    $results.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Shell='module'; Test='exports and private worker'; Status='PASS'; Detail='' })
+} finally {
+    if ($EvidencePath) {
+        $payload = [ordered]@{ SchemaVersion=1; Suite='real read-only CLI shell invocations'; PowerShellVersion=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString(); Results=@($results.ToArray()) }
+        [IO.File]::WriteAllText([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($EvidencePath),($payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8),$utf8)
+    }
+    Remove-Module Whinset -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+    $resolved = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($testRoot)
+    $temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()).TrimEnd('\') + '\'
+    if ($resolved.StartsWith($temp,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -and (Split-Path $resolved -Leaf) -like 'Whinset-shell-*') { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $resolved -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
+}
+$failed = @($results | Where-Object Status -eq FAIL).Count
+Write-Output "$(@($results | Where-Object Status -eq PASS).Count) passed; $failed failed"
+if ($failed) { exit 1 }
+exit 0

+#!/usr/bin/env nu
+# Experimental argument-forwarding adapter; no installation logic lives here.
+def --wrapped main [...args: string] {
+    let core = ($env.FILE_PWD | path join 'whinset.ps1')
+    if (which pwsh.exe | is-not-empty) {
+        ^pwsh.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -File $core ...$args
+    } else {
+        ^powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -File $core ...$args
+    }
+    exit $env.LAST_EXIT_CODE
+}

+# Experimental Git Bash adapter. All execution remains in the PowerShell core.

+  exec pwsh.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -File "$root/whinset.ps1" "$@"
+fi
